preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the string s must be between 1 and 10^6.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l < r <= len(s) for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices l and r within the bounds of the string s.

preconditions.expression: all((r - l) % 2 == 0 for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must specify a substring of even length.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum cost to make the substring a correct bracket sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cost, int) and cost >= 0 for cost in costs)
postconditions.description: Each output cost must be a non-negative integer.
